recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Chipotle Bean Spread
instructions: Add all of the bean spread ingredients to a small food processor. Blend until smooth.
Add the oil to a large pan over medium-high heat. Grill the bread for 1 to 2 minutes per side, or until toasted. Set aside.
Heat some more oil to the now-empty pan. Cook the corn for 4 to 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, or until the corn has some golden brown spots.
Top the toasted bread with chipotle bean spread, corn, avocado, and green onion. Garnish and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † The chipotle sauce we use is a blend of chipotle peppers with water, vinegar, and spices. It's a deep red-coloured sauce. Some chipotle sauces are mayo-based, and we do not recommend using these versions in this recipe.
Storage The spread can be stored separately from the bread and the toppings in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
